seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个基因、基因型、Day15 样本的 mRNA 测量和生物学重复 ID。
原始 Ct/表达量、内参和归一化方法；保留技术重复与生物学重复的对应关系。
组间比较与多重检验、误差定义；P 值不能从图片恢复计算过程。
en: mRNA measurement and biological replicate ID for each gene/genotype at Day15.
Raw Ct/expression, reference controls and normalization; preserve technical-to-biological replicate mapping.
Group comparisons, multiplicity correction and error definition; a screenshot cannot recover the P-value calculation.

preprocessing.zh: 先归一化 mRNA 表达，再填每组重复值；默认重算均值和 SEM，不做新的显著性检验。
preprocessing.en: Normalize mRNA upstream, then supply replicate values. Default replacement-data summaries are mean/SEM; no new significance test is run.
